correctness.rationale: The bipartite adjacency matrix has an m x (2m+1) block containing an identity on private-leaf columns, so rank is 2m, nullity m+1, and kernel vectors vanish on the rim shore. Standard zero-forcing kernel injectivity enforces Z>=m+1 and minimum sets wholly in W. The explicit x_i plus one p_j construction forces all, giving equality. For a minimum B, initially blue leaves define T; chronological forces on white hub/subdivision vertices Q must be a perfect matching from T, and alternating cycles would contradict the force order, so it must be unique. Conversely matching acyclic dependency sinks give a legal forcing schedule. Cyclic selected runs of lengths ell_i contribute products of (ell_i+1) and sum ell_i products for hub absent/present, and circular run generating functions give t^3(24-92t+101t²-42t³+6t⁴)/((1-t)(1-3t+t²)^2), with the spurious m=2 term subtracted. Independent complete enumeration checked minima for m=3..6 as 24,76,225,649.
residual_risks: m>=3, exactly one subdivision per rim edge and one private leaf per original rim vertex.
Computational values m3..6 do not certify rational function at all lengths.
